reviews.t: I have chronically dry skin and it has a tendency to look dull, this product solves that problem for me
reviews.x: I received this product heavily discounted. For ladies or gentlemen  who are unfamiliar with how Retinol works, let me explain. Retinoids work by prompting surface skin cells to turn over and die rapidly, making way for new cell growth underneath. They hamper the breakdown of collagen and thicken the deeper layer of skin where wrinkles get their start. There is a myth that it thins the skin and this is simply not true.
